The trusted publisher on npmjs.com allows `npm stage publish` but not
`npm publish`, so the v5.1.0 tag push failed with a 403 "OIDC permission
denied for this action" after authenticating and signing provenance.

Staging keeps a human in the loop: a tag push uploads the tarball and
signs provenance, then the release is promoted with `npm stage approve`
or from the package page. A tag push alone can no longer put a version
on the registry.
